chunks: Ibn al-Walid, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Murazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) saw his Lord, Mighty and Majestic - that is - by his heart.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad see God with his physical eyes or his heart?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Tawhid, transmitted through the chain of Ibn al-Walid, clarifies the Shia doctrine of *Basar al-Qalb* (vision of the heart), asserting that the Prophet Muhammad witnessed God through spiritual insight rather than physical ocular perception. It serves as a primary evidence against anthropomorphism (*Tajsim*) and supports the view that divine vision is a metaphysical reality accessible to the purified soul, distinct from the physical sight of creation.
